name: Assamite Sorcery (Awakening of the Steel) — 1 Basic — Grasp of the Mountain

system.description: You reinforce the spiritual bond between blade and swordsman so the weapon never leaves your hand unless you will it. Spend a Mental Trait. For the rest of the scene, you may add your Mental Traits to your Physical Traits to resist attempts to disarm you, and you cannot accidentally drop the weapon. If somehow disarmed, you may call the blade back to your hand by winning a Static Mental Challenge with a difficulty equal to the number of paces between you and the weapon. You must have a total number of Ability Traits in Melee and Crafts: Blacksmith equal to your level of mastery in this path; using this power on a weapon other than a sword or knife costs an additional Blood Trait.
